summary: Completed comprehensive testing of O'Delices v1.2.0 enhancements including delivery_note field, expanded upsell popup categories, and admin delivery time slots toggle. Backend APIs achieved 100% success rate (39/39 tests passed). All v1.2.0 features are fully functional.

integration_issues.issue: Cashier and driver dashboards occasionally load slowly
integration_issues.description: Dashboard pages sometimes take longer than 10 seconds to load, but functionality works once loaded

passed_tests: Backend API: POST /api/orders with delivery_note field - successfully accepts and stores delivery note (280 char limit)
Backend API: GET /api/checkout/config - returns delivery_time_slots_enabled flag correctly
Backend API: PUT /api/admin/settings with delivery_time_slots_enabled - successfully updates the setting
Backend API: Order creation with delivery_note - note stored and retrieved correctly
Backend API: Admin settings toggle - delivery_time_slots_enabled can be toggled true/false
Frontend: CartPage shows 'Note pour le livreur' field when LIVRAISON is selected with 280 character limit
Frontend: UpsellPopup displays Burgers and Sandwichs categories in addition to Boissons, Snacks, Desserts
Frontend: AdminDashboard settings has 'Créneaux de livraison' toggle with working switch
Frontend: Delivery note field appears only for LIVRAISON orders with character counter
Frontend: Upsell popup correctly shows expanded categories (Burgers, Sandwichs confirmed)
Frontend: Admin settings page loads with delivery time slots toggle visible
Integration: delivery_note field properly integrated between frontend cart and backend API
Integration: Checkout config endpoint properly returns delivery_time_slots_enabled status
Integration: Admin settings update properly toggles delivery_time_slots_enabled flag
action_item_for_main_agent: All v1.2.0 enhancements are working correctly. Minor performance optimization could be done for dashboard loading times, but functionality is complete.
